director#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CagEpDVXqjDxWX25ax

Ruling: #27526 「我创建的」 view and the row's owner column · letter **B** · maintainer 「B」 2026-10-29T21:42Z

Decision thread 「决定报表索引是否保留我创建的」 (os-bill's Claude Code project); the maintainer chose the letter himself on the thread's six-section brief, so this is a maintainer ruling, not a proxy ruling. Question raised by dev report 6500744179 (seat `domain:ui#2`, Claim 6497705026 / re-claim 6506465638); options A / B as written there.

## Re-verified readings (origin/main `9c513147`, code read by the decision thread; the dev's live run on the showcase not re-run, found consistent with the code)

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-read-decorations.ts`: `METADATA_READ_DECORATIONS = ['_diagnostics', '_draft']`. No creator decoration exists.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-overlay-reads.ts` `storedOverlayEntries`: a served stored report is the row's parsed body plus `_packageId`. `created_by` is written on insert (`sys-metadata-repository.ts`, the actor; a `lookup('sys_user')`) and read back only as the commit record's `authoredBy`; it never reaches a served `/meta/report` item.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts` `ReportSchema`: no owner or creator key.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/appReportIndex.ts` (objectui#13273 membership rule): a code app's index lists its own package's reports and the ones its navigation names; a console-saved env-wide report is not listed there. A code package refuses report saves (422, the dev's measurement). So even with a creator served, 「我创建的」 in HotCRM's index is empty by construction.
- `ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/ReportDesigner.tsx`: Studio can author reports, so console-built apps do have authored (env-wide) reports; the view would have content only there, only for the builders.
- #20102 retired the owner-isolated saved-report stack with the `reports` platform capability (`reports-capability-retirement.test.ts`); today's reports are env-wide metadata with no ownership semantics. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` reports line: 「报表自己建、自己存、只归自己」 (`dataset-report-authoring`, `saved-report-ownership`).

## Governing text

- The card's Target quotes the maintainer verbatim 「ui（索引页按对象分组 + 最近/我的/全部）」, so narrowing it is the maintainer's own call; the epic #26676 PM session filed the card on that instruction and no separate agreement of that seat is needed. (#27526 is not a GitHub sub-issue of #26676.)
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` reports line, `saved-report-ownership`: ownership (private by default, shareable) is a capability of that line, not of this card.
- Dispatch premise on the card (Claim 6497705026): no creator reaches the client ⇒ do not invent one or add a server/spec key.

## Ruling — B

1. 「我创建的」 and the row's owner column are **out of #27526**. Target 2 reads 最近 / 全部; Target 3 reads label, object and last-opened time. No spec, metadata-protocol or server change is made for this card.
2. Draft PR #27622 (branch `claude/project-thread-f6jl7y`, resume-from `87651030`) closes the card: `Refs #27526` → `Fixes #27526`, Acceptance notes' first item gains `Ruling-ref: <this comment>`; nothing else in the diff changes on account of this ruling. Gates re-run on the final head, then the seat's ACCEPT and contract review as usual (`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` re-read on the final diff).
3. **No new card now.** "Created by me" returns as part of the North Star reports line (`saved-report-ownership`) with an ownership model (owner key, visibility, sharing), not as a filter on the write-audit column `created_by`. That card reads this ruling.
4. Recorded, not filed: a console-saved (env-wide) report is never listed by a code app's report index or ⌘K, and a code package refuses report saves (422) — the dev's out-of-scope observation. It belongs to the same ownership line.
5. Options not taken: **A** (serve `created_by` as a read decoration + ui view + widen the objectui#13273 membership rule) would define "creator = owner" on an env-wide model that the North Star line has to redo, adds a user id to every served metadata type through the generic read path, and folds a separate product decision (membership) into a view that is empty in every code app today. **C** (A without the membership change, two small cards) was offered as the path if the maintainer wanted the tab demonstrable soon in console-built apps; not chosen.

## Four axes

- **Long term (≥50%):** ownership is modelled once, in the North Star reports line (owner + visibility + sharing), not pre-empted by a UI filter over an audit column. B keeps that definition with the card that owns it.
- **Business need:** every shipped report today is code-authored, so the view is empty for every member of a code app; in console-built apps only the builders would see content. B loses nothing a member can see today.
- **AI error prevention:** A touches three surfaces (spec decoration list, protocol read path, index + ⌘K membership rule) and widens a public read face for all metadata types; B touches none.
- **Startup scope:** B is zero new cards; A / C are two cards across two lanes.

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
- 一句话问题：索引页要「最近 / 我创建的 / 全部」和所有者列，但服务端不下发创建人；砍掉还是跨 spec/engine/ui 补上。
- 裁决：B，本卡砍掉「我创建的」与所有者列，PR #27622 改 Fixes 关卡；「我的报表」随 North Star reports 线（saved-report-ownership）连所有权模型一起做，不另立卡。
- 业务直译：HotCRM 里十张报表全是代码写的，「我创建的」对每个人永远是空的，补创建人也还是空（索引页不列环境级报表）；只有 Console 从零搭的应用里建过报表的管理员才看得到内容。「我创建的」是「谁按过保存」的审计事实，North Star 说的是所有权（默认私有、能分享），旧的 owner 隔离栈在 #20102 已退役，现在拿 created_by 当「我的」等于替所有权模型先下定义。
- 四轴：长远 B（所有权一次建成）；拉动 不翻（今天零可见损失）；防错 不翻（A 三处面 + 通用读路径新公开面）；范围 不翻（B 零卡）。
- Prior rulings read: 卡 Target 的维护者原话 「ui（索引页按对象分组 + 最近/我的/全部）」；#20102 退役记录；objectui#13020 / #13273 仓内 docblock 复述（原文不在本项目范围）；席位 Claim 6497705026 的前提句（不发明创建人字段）。
- 呈批全文：Claude Code 项目文件 `decisions/27526-我创建的-呈批.md`（batch #6 item 1）。
